resources.string: Could not bring the tunnel up. Try connecting again
Another app or the system took the VPN permission — the tunnel is closed and traffic goes around it. Connect again once the other VPN is off
Failed to apply the subscription «%1$s»: %2$s. «%3$s» keeps running. Check your own edits in the override, if you made any
Failed to apply the subscription «%1$s»: %2$s. The previous configuration keeps running. Check your own edits in the override, if you made any
The system did not allow the tunnel to be created. Try connecting again
The service was restarted by the system %1$d times in a row. Automatic restart is paused — open the app and connect again
The system did not allow the service to start in the background. Open the app and connect again
Always-on VPN cannot start while the proxy-only mode is active. Turn off always-on VPN or enable «Route system traffic»
The draft changed while the subscription was loading, so nothing was saved. Try again
The file name is not allowed: %1$s

The provider redirected the request to an unencrypted address, so it was refused: the subscription and the device details would have travelled in the clear. This is a misconfiguration on the provider side — ask them about it
The clock on the device is far off, and the provider rejected the request. Set the date and time to automatic and try again
The provider answer failed the secure channel check. Try again; if it repeats, the provider address may have been substituted
The provider answered with something the secure channel does not understand: the address is not a Clod Clash subscription, or the channel is not supported there
The subscription contains no servers and no providers. Ask the provider — usually the subscription has expired or run out of traffic
The answer is too large for a subscription and was not accepted
The subscription address is in an unsupported scheme. It has to be an https link
The provider refused access (code %1$d). The subscription may have expired, or the device limit is reached
The provider did not find this subscription (code %1$d). The address may have changed — take a fresh link from the provider
The provider server is having trouble (code %1$d). This is on their side, try again later
